items.name: Mr. Sanjay D’Souza
items.role: Group Head-Emerging & Informal Micro Enterprises Group
items.profile_quote: Mr. Sanjay D’Souza joined the Bank on December 1, 1999 and has close to 25 years of experience with the Bank. He has a diverse work experience in the Bank spanning Retail Credit, Wholesale Credit and Emerging Enterprises Group. Mr. D’Souza has been heading business for Emerging Enterprises Group since October 2016 and Micro Enterprises Group was added to his portfolio effective February 2024.

method: Quotes from eligible appointment filings already in the corpus; not a complete management history.
